title.narrative: Amendmments to the Law on State Aid prepared/ adoptes

description.narrative: Amendmments to the Law on State Aid prepared/ adoptes

comment.narrative: amendments to the Law are prepared but not adopted yet end November the Project supported the organisation of the Working Group meeting working on the ammendments to the Law which will result in the preparing of the preliminary version of the State Aid Law to be submitted to the Legal Department of the Ministry of Finance Labour and Transfers MFLT for further processing. In November 2023 the Project has further supported the Working Group during a special threeday session where the participants of the Working Group meeting discussed issues concerning the purpose scope of the Law application of the notification exemption to aid of a social character as well as aid intended to provide remedies fordamages caused by natural disasters or emergency events the duties and responsibilities of the SAD and the SAC the requirements of the Law that will apply to State aid schemes that were established before 7 February 2017 and that have not been notified to the Department andor have not been accepted by the SAC and some linguistic issues.
